title: PHANTOM: A LARGE-SCALE DATASET OF MULTIMODAL ADVERSARIAL ATTACKS FOR VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Translating adversarial textual prompts into high-resource (e.g., Italian, German) and low-resource (e.g., Farsi, Turkish) languages, as well as mixed-language settings, and comparing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) to identify cross-lingual vulnerabilities and disparities in safety alignment.

Generating and testing multimodal adversarial attacks (image-text pairs) based on intents specifically categorized under 'Bias and Discrimination' and 'Discriminatory Behavior' within the Ethical and Social Risks taxonomy, evaluating model compliance using an automated safety judge.

Evaluating model robustness against multimodal adversarial jailbreaks designed to elicit 'Cultural or Religious Offense' (Subcategory G4), measuring the attack success rate via an automated classifier.

Testing vision-language models against adversarial samples targeting 'Political Propaganda' and 'Election Interference' (Subcategories F3 and F4), analyzing the models' susceptibility to generating manipulative political content.
